name: diag-log
summary: DIAGNOSTIC: RAM event log (ms time stamps) of panel on/off callers, OSD timer expiry, the standby gate and start-up milestones; read with diag-poke + tools/logread.py

edits.asm: diag-log hook stubs (linker padding 0x203A9C)
diag-log 1 ms ISR stub (linker padding 0x203CE0)
diag-log log routine (linker padding 0x203B08); data at 0x203968-0x2039EF
diag-log start-up milestone stubs (linker padding 0x203BA3)
diag-log mailbox exit stub (linker padding 0x2038AA)
diag-log mailbox entry stub and a checkpoint (linker padding 0x203FB8); scratch 0x2039F0-0x2039F5
b.addi -> j isr (1 ms ISR entry: ms counter)
b.addi -> j h_off (sub_245860 entry (panel off))
b.sw -> j h_on (sub_245919+5 (panel on))
b.addi -> j h_sig (sub_258AB1 entry (re-enter No signal))
b.addi -> j h_st4 (sub_26A7C5 entry (OSD state 4 entry))
b.jal -> j h_gate (jal standby_gate_query in the power-save entry)
b.ori -> j m_init (sub_261FDE after the prologue (main init start))
b.jal -> j m_dev (jal sub_23FF28 after sub_23D3EB (init done))
b.movhi -> j m_loop (movhi r10,0x45 before the main loop)
b.ori -> j m_bl (sub_245919 backlight-on step)
b.movhi -> j mb_in (mailbox_query: movhi r14,0x45 after the argument moves (start time, command))
b.lwz -> j h_mb (mailbox_query epilogue: lwz r19/r18 (log if >= 20 ms); 0x239006-07 unused)
b.jal -> j c_261faf (jal sub_239BAE: time stamp after it returns)
b.jal -> j c_2688ab (jal sub_268668: time stamp after it returns)
b.jal -> j c_2688c5 (jal sub_239223: time stamp after it returns)
b.jal -> j c_2688df (jal sub_239223: time stamp after it returns)

notes: Log at 0x203968 (ms counter), 0x20396C (event count), 0x203970 (16 x 8-byte ring: ms, tag<<24 | value). tools/logread.py maps the tags (see 'tags') to F (panel off), N (panel on), S (OSD timer expiry), E (state 4 entry), G (gate result), I (main init start), D (init done), M (main loop start), B (backlight on), C (after a start-up call, c_<call address>), Q (mailbox transaction >= 20 ms: cmd << 16 | sub << 12 | duration / 2 ms). The log is in RAM and starts empty at every firmware start. Generated by tools/patches_src_diag_log.py.
